title: How Should Teachers Be Prepared? RL on Student-Induced States for On-Policy Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.04950v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves the reasoning capabilities of small language models through token-level teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. Yet can teachers that excel at solving problems independently also guide student reasoning effectively? Prior work shows that when student prefixes follow reasoning paths that differ from the teacher's own or contain errors, teachers can be less accurate when continuing from these prefixes than when solving problems independently. To this end, we propose Prep-OPD, which uses reinforcement learning (RL) before distillation to train the teacher to adapt to the student's existing reasoning state and correct course when errors arise. Training optimizes teacher continuations from fixed student prefixes using final-answer correctness as the reward. The prepared teacher then trains the student through trajectory guidance and token-level supervision. We evaluate Prep-OPD on eight

translated_title: 教师应如何备课？基于学生诱导状态的强化学习用于在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）通过在学生生成的轨迹上施加token级别的教师监督，来提升小语言模型的推理能力。然而，擅长独立解题的教师是否也能有效引导学生的推理？先前的工作表明，当学生的前缀遵循与教师自身不同的推理路径或包含错误时，教师在这些前缀基础上续写的准确率可能低于独立解题时的准确率。为此，我们提出了Prep-OPD，它在蒸馏之前使用强化学习（RL）来训练教师适应学生已有的推理状态，并在出现错误时进行纠正。训练以最终答案的正确性作为奖励，优化教师从固定学生前缀出发的续写。经过准备的教师随后通过轨迹引导和token级别监督来训练学生。我们在八个（任务/数据集上对Prep-OPD进行了评估……原文此处截断）
tldr: 提出Prep-OPD方法，在蒸馏前先用强化学习训练教师模型以适应学生的推理状态并在出错时纠偏，从而显著提升在线策略蒸馏中小语言模型的推理能力。
en_tdlr: Proposes Prep-OPD, which uses reinforcement learning before distillation to prepare teachers to adapt to student-induced reasoning states and correct errors, thereby improving small language model reasoning in on-policy distillation.
